experts.name: Bradley Stalder
experts.bio: Bradley Stalder is noted for his exceptional skills and insightful analysis. Over the past two years, he has consistently demonstrated his expertise, securing seven Top-15 weekly finishes in the prestigious FantasyPros Accuracy Rankings Contest. Notably, Bradley achieved the coveted #1 spot in Week 17 of 2021, solidifying his position as a leading authority in the field. As a seasoned veteran in the fantasy football , having played for over a decade, Bradley has excelled in various formats, including redraft, bestball, and dynasty leagues. He is renowned for his data-driven approach and has garnered a reputation for providing some of the most accurate projections in the industry. Bradley’s keen understanding of the game has led him to contribute as a writer for esteemed platforms such as FantasyData and Top Prop Fantasy. His projections and analysis yielded an impressive 62% win rate for his Weekly Top Prop Fantasy Article series in 2022. Bradley’s expertise has also been recognized by numerous podcasts, making him a sought-after guest on shows like FFPC high stakes podcast, FantasyPros, Draft Sharks, Mind of Mansion, Grind Time, Off the Schneid, FF Mad Scientist, P2W Fantasy, the Fantasy Dog Pound, the Fantasy Frontline, Fantasy Football Origin Stories, and the GOAT DISTRICT. His ability to identify breakout players and uncover hidden gems has earned him admiration among fantasy football enthusiasts. Notably, Bradley has a knack for identifying deep-cut league winners like Robert Tonyan and Isaiah Hodgins, further solidifying his status as a sharp drafter, player, and analyst.
